# NEW 2026-11-18 Yuan track Y3 (inner provinces). Generated by tools_20261117/gen_yuan_y3.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Design and engine assumptions: work/plan_20261117/research_1337/regions/yuan_y3.md
# Unit variables at on_game_start (like oe_theme_regions). The countries' variables, a missing seat office or subject
# relation, and the governors are checked after the lobby (when vanilla china_set_up has certainly run, so the loyalty start
# value sees yua_dictator_powers). Both are guarded by global variables and run once per campaign.
on_game_start = { on_actions = { oe_yp_game_start } }
on_game_started_after_lobby = { on_actions = { oe_yp_after_lobby } }
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_yp_monthly_pulse oe_yp_collapse_pulse } }
on_new_country_formed = { on_actions = { oe_yp_formed } }

oe_yp_game_start = {
    effect = { oe_yp_assign_units = yes }
}
oe_yp_after_lobby = {
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_started } }
            set_global_variable = oe_yp_started
            oe_yp_assign_units = yes
            oe_yp_setup_countries = yes
            oe_yp_setup_rulers = yes
        }
    }
}
oe_yp_monthly_pulse = {
    # round 6: the frontier branch secretariats (land subjects, oe_yp_frontier) too
    # round 7 F6 (Y2): not after the secretariat or the whole Yuan has ended, and only under the Yuan itself (after vanilla
    # .101 the old Yuan is YUA and c:CHI another dynasty, whose land must not get tier modifiers before the anchor's check runs)
    trigger = {
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved }
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_yp_ended }
        OR = { AND = { country_type = building is_subject_type = oe_yp_xingsheng } is_subject_type = oe_yp_frontier }
        oe_yp_yuan_fallen = no
        is_subject_of = c:CHI
    }
    effect = { oe_yp_monthly = yes }
}
# Round 7 F6 (Y2). root = the newly formed country. The CHI tag formed (CHI_f: the Yuan re-founding the Mandate in vanilla
# red_turban_rebellions.105, or a new dynasty after .101 or flavor_chi.33), or the Yuan's own country formed YUA_f (.101,
# flavor_chi.33): the Yuan as the branch secretariats knew it has ended (reason 6).
oe_yp_formed = {
    trigger = {
        has_global_variable = oe_yp_started
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved }
        OR = {
            tag = CHI
            AND = { tag = YUA has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan global_var:oe_yp_yuan ?= this }
        }
    }
    effect = { oe_yp_dissolve_all = { reason = 6 } }
}
# Round 7 F6 (Y2). The monthly collapse check, run by one anchor: CHI while it exists (the Yuan, or the dynasty that took the
# tag, which then finds the Yuan fallen); else YUA (the Northern Yuan); else any branch secretariat still standing.
oe_yp_collapse_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        has_global_variable = oe_yp_started
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved }
        OR = {
            tag = CHI
            AND = { tag = YUA NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } }
            AND = { has_variable = oe_yp_unit NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } NOT = { country_exists = c:YUA } }
        }
    }
    effect = { oe_yp_collapse_check = yes }
}
